source: ijapp backlog U277, U279, U280, U283 (firm task management + workflows), deployed and enabled on prod Nov 2026

hook.sub: Task management is now live in InvestorJoint.

points.title: Board or list, your way
points.body: Drag cards between lanes you name yourself, or switch to a list.

points.title: Everything on the card
points.body: Several assignees, checklists, labels, files, dates and custom fields.

points.title: Linked to the real work
points.body: Tie a task to a property, entity or contact, or make one from an email.

points.title: Workflows that run themselves
points.body: Staged steps by role, repeating monthly or quarterly, or started when a lease is signed.

points.title: Nothing slips through
points.body: Bell and email alerts when you're assigned, and reminders when work is due or overdue.
